description: Canonical, language-neutral agent tool catalog shared across agent products (laintas_cli, Helpwo, future agents). Single source of truth for tool NAMES, parameter JSON Schemas, and execution context. Per-language adapters (Python/TS) consume this. Names are flat snake_case with NO dots (DeepSeek and other providers reject '.' in function names). Product-specific legacy names are recorded under `aliases` to support a migration window.

conventions.naming: flat snake_case, no dots, no namespaces; extensions use a source prefix (e.g. mcp__server__tool), the core stays unprefixed
conventions.execContext: host = runs where the OS/files live (CLI local PTY, remote agent); browser = runs in the user's browser/local workspace; backend = runs server-side (gateway); either = location-agnostic / logical
conventions.result_envelope: { ok: bool, result?: any, error?: string, diff?: string } — every executor returns this shape

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a file as UTF-8 text. Supports offset/limit for large files. Output is line-numbered (cat -n style).

tools.name: write
tools.description: Overwrite (or create) a file with the provided UTF-8 content.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Exact string replacement in a file. Replace old_string with new_string; set replace_all when old_string is not unique.

replace_all.description: replace all occurrences (required if not unique)

tools.name: multi_edit
tools.description: Apply multiple find/replace edits to one file atomically (all-or-nothing).

tools.name: ls
tools.description: List directory entries (one level): name, type, size.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files by glob pattern (e.g. **/*.py).

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents by regex; returns matching lines with locations.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Show a unified diff between a file's current content and proposed content.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move or rename a file/directory.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete a file or directory only when the user explicitly requested that exact deletion or approved a plan containing it. Do not use as inferred cleanup or secret handling.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a synchronous non-interactive shell command and capture stdout/stderr/exit code. Deployment terminals are lifecycle containers, not shared command streams. Use session tools for a private interactive PTY and terminal.send only for input to an already-running program.

tools.name: agent_spawn
tools.description: Spawn a sub-agent with a goal; it runs its own loop and reports back.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.description: Send a message to a named/known agent's inbox.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List known/child agents and their status.

tools.name: agent_return
tools.description: Submit declared HWO output values to the caller. This records outputs and does not terminate the agent.

value.description: String or structured object. Use an object when the HWO agent declares out(...).

tools.name: agent_wait
tools.description: Block until a spawned agent (or all spawns) completes, then collect results.

target.description: agent id; omit to wait for all spawns

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Save a persistent memory that survives across sessions.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search/list persistent memories by relevance.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read a specific memory by name.

tools.name: task_create
tools.description: Create a tracked task.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Update a task's status or fields.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: List tracked tasks.

tools.name: task_get
tools.description: Get one task by id.

tools.name: task_complete
tools.description: Explicitly finish the current user task after verification and all durable completion hooks are satisfied.

tools.name: workflow_phase_complete
tools.description: Complete one non-gated workflow phase; this does not complete the overall user task.

tools.name: rule_save
tools.description: Persist an explicit recurring or cross-session user rule without relying on keyword matching.

tools.name: rule_list
tools.description: List structured durable user rules.

tools.name: rule_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a durable rule after an explicit user withdrawal or replacement.

tools.name: rule_mark_satisfied
tools.description: Mark a durable completion hook fulfilled for the current task.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Find relevant authorized native capabilities by intent and expose matching schemas on the next model turn. Discovery never grants permission.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and extract its text content.

tools.name: download_url
tools.description: Download one CORS-enabled HTTP(S) file directly in the browser and save it to the current workspace without a server proxy.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return result snippets.

tools.name: code_map_build
tools.description: Queue a layered architecture map of a public GitHub repository. Returns a map id; the build takes minutes to hours.

model.description: model id; omit for the service default

prompts.description: replacement prompt text keyed by stage: l1_brief, l1_plan, l2_design

tools.name: code_map_status
tools.description: How far a queued code map build has got.

tools.name: code_map_list
tools.description: The account's code maps and how many more it may keep.

tools.name: code_map_read
tools.description: Read a finished code map as text: the whole system, one part (node=l1:<id>), or one component's declarations with file:line (node=l2:<part>:<component>).

node.description: box id; omit for the whole map

tools.name: code_map_delete
tools.description: Delete one code map, freeing the slot it holds.

tools.name: ppos_account
tools.description: Read the signed-in PPOS account.

tools.name: ppos_storage
tools.description: Read PPOS storage usage, limits, and the per-work breakdown.

tools.name: ppos_communities
tools.description: List PPOS communities and roles.

tools.name: ppos_works
tools.description: List the caller's PPOS works with the storage each one occupies.

tools.name: ppos_work
tools.description: Read one PPOS work in full, including its Markdown source.

tools.name: ppos_work_update
tools.description: Edit one of your PPOS works: title, tags, self score, community, or replacement Markdown (its media is uploaded). Editing text re-enters review and re-charges the $1 review fee.

tools.name: ppos_work_delete
tools.description: Delete one of your PPOS works and free the storage quota it occupied.

tools.name: ppos_storage_cleanup
tools.description: Find, and optionally delete, PPOS media that no live work references any more (leftovers from failed publishes or deleted works). Dry run by default.

tools.name: ppos_draft_save
tools.description: Save Markdown as a private PPOS draft, or replace an existing draft. Media is uploaded, but no review is requested and no review fee is charged.

tools.name: ppos_publish
tools.description: Publish Markdown to PPOS, optionally replacing and submitting an existing private draft. Relative local images and videos are uploaded into PPOS storage and their links rewritten.

tools.name: ppos_comment
tools.description: Post a comment with an optional 0-100 rating.

tools.name: ppos_community_review_queue
tools.description: Read a community moderation queue.

tools.name: ppos_community_review_decide
tools.description: Approve, reject, or escalate a community review with evidence.

tools.name: ppos_platform_review_queue
tools.description: Read the admin-only platform review queue.

tools.name: ppos_platform_review_decide
tools.description: Approve, reject, or escalate an admin-only platform review.

tools.name: hwo
tools.description: Run / manage an HWO multi-agent workflow.
